info.name: Execute a GraphQL query or mutation against a graph.

params.name: graph
params.description: The name of the graph, e.g. "default".

items.docs: Hasura-backed GraphQL endpoint over the Faros canonical model. Accepts a standard GraphQL request body (query, variables, operationName) and returns a GraphQL response. Used to query SDLC entities and to write data via GraphQL mutations.
